reason: Independent review (GPT, on b7dc326) found defects in tools/idea_screen.py v1. v1 results are RETRACTED as the formal screen; v2 below is registered BEFORE it is run. The 6 ideas and their thresholds are unchanged; only the measurement is repaired.
changes: C1 No future-conditioned filtering: the |fwd return|<=60% filter is REMOVED. All returns enter as observed. Events/benchmark with |fwd|>60% are only COUNTED and reported (no exclusion, no clipping).

C2 I4: no clip, no fillna(0). Buy-and-hold equal-weight of names eligible at t0 from close t0 to close t1. Benchmark = identically-costed buy-and-hold of the same eligible set over every other window of the same length in the same period; excess = TOM-window net minus the mean of those windows (per month).
C3 Costs: round trip fee+slippage 0.96% PLUS impact 2*0.25*(250000/ADV20_t) per name, applied to events AND benchmark. Missing/zero ADV => no trade (event not formed, logged).

C4 Declustering uses ENTRY-based information only (signal and ex-ante eligibility at t); an event whose outcome is later missing still blocks the next H sessions and is counted as MISSING (not dropped silently). Missing share must be <=5% per idea/window or the idea cannot be a candidate.
C5 Every exclusion/missing event is written to an events CSV with ticker, date, status.
C6 All thresholds are read from the parameters block below, not hardcoded.
C7 RSI: no losses in window and gains>0 => RSI=100; gains=0 and losses=0 => undefined => no signal.

C8 Multiplicity disclosed: alpha=0.05/6 covers only these 6 ideas. Project-wide cumulative test count is larger, so the lower bound is ALSO reported at alpha_strict=0.001. Candidate status requires the strict one.
pass_rule: unchanged, plus: lower bound at alpha_strict > 0, missing share <= 5%. Nothing licenses an executable recommendation.
